title: Esquiva 3D — standalone cube dodge/shrinking-floor demo scene
description: Client review pivoted the demo away from the 2D WarioWare microgames toward a 3D look using basic cubes. Build a NEW standalone single-player 3D dodge/survival scene (no integration with the existing microgame sequencer/HUD). Top-down diagonal (isometric-ish) camera. Floor is an N×N grid of cube tiles that collapses ring-by-ring from the outside inward, falling into the void (shrinking arena). Player cube must avoid falling off the remaining tiles and avoid being touched by chaser-cube obstacles, which also fall into the void when their tile is gone. Pure rules engine-free in Barcade.Core (fast-suite covered); thin MonoBehaviour bootstrap builds visuals procedurally and relays input; Editor SceneBuilder (-executeMethod-able) creates Assets/Barcade/Scenes/Esquiva3D.unity. Supersedes the paused TASK-018 readability pass as the active demo direction.
acceptance_criteria: Pure logic GridArena (ring-by-ring outside-in collapse schedule, IsSolid, center edge case) and DodgeSim (player fall detection, caught-by-obstacle detection, obstacle fall, win-by-timer, win-by-all-obstacles-fallen, Playing/Won/Lost state machine) live in Barcade.Core with no UnityEngine dependency

New EditMode/fast-suite tests written FIRST cover the collapse order/timing, fall/caught/win conditions, and state transitions; fast dotnet suite stays green including the new tests (existing 229 not broken)

Thin DodgeGameBootstrap MonoBehaviour procedurally builds the cube grid + player + obstacle cubes, reads input, calls sim.Tick, syncs Transforms (tile-fall animation, obstacle/player movement), and auto-restarts on win/lose; no game rules in Update()

Editor SceneBuilder method (MenuItem + -executeMethod target) generates Assets/Barcade/Scenes/Esquiva3D.unity with a diagonal top-down perspective camera, directional light, and the bootstrap GameObject
Project compiles clean in the Unity Editor (verified by orchestrator via MCP/recompile); scene opens and is visibly playable with cubes (human UAT)
Fully additive: existing 2D microgame view code and sequencer untouched

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
CLOSED on green review + human UAT pass ("perfecto", 2026-06-27).

Human UAT: Esquiva 3D scene plays; iterated to map 21x21, runtime camera auto-fit, wider enemy spawn (radius 0.45), and player visibly falls into the void on death (no freeze). Controls WASD/left-stick.

Verification: fast dotnet suite 261/261 green (32 new Dodge tests, 0 regressions). Independent reviewer (fresh context) verdict APPROVE-WITH-NITS, NO HIGH findings. Confirmed Core purity (no UnityEngine), thin-MonoBehaviour adherence, correct ring-collapse math + fall/caught/win logic, idempotent SceneBuilder, and fully additive (no 2D microgame/sequencer file touched).

Commits (master, pushed to origin https://github.com/lordiwa/barcade.git): eaff947, f10a9b1, 191a986, 2bb3f62, 454a263, 3c0bf29, 864cc12.

Non-gating follow-ups (LOW, deferred): (1) guard fallSpeed>0 (or timeout the death WaitUntil) so a bad Inspector value can't hang the restart; (2) add a test asserting diagonal-input normalization (DodgeSim.cs:201). Plus minor NITs: stale test comment (DodgeSimTests.cs:81), fragile float-boundary test (DodgeSimTests.cs:138), obstacle fall starts from prev-frame XZ (cosmetic).
